messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly health check for Acme Retail (acct: acme-retail). TL;DR: tokens WoW -4%, QoQ +15%. Throughput p50 95ms, p95 270ms (up ~30ms WoW). Error rate 0.8% (was 0.2% last week) — spike around 10:20 PDT tied to a bulk ingestion batch job. Spend +9% WoW. Summary + action items below.

aj_kapoor: Which routes/models saw the latency and error spike — gen or embeddings? any one client doing large concurrent requests?

maria_cs: Early look shows most of the errors + latency from /v1/generate on model gptx-13b in the eu-west pool. Small portion from gptx-3.5-multi used for chat fallback. Quick breakdown: 
```
route,model,WoW_tokens_change,QoQ_tokens_change,p95_latency_ms,errors_pct
/generate,gptx-13b,-6%,+18%,270,1.4%
/chat,gptx-3.5-multi,+2%,+9%,160,0.2%
/embeddings,text-embed-2,-1%,+3%,95,0.05%
```

ben_platform: Looks like a scheduled batch inference job (job id 0x9f) started at 10:18 PDT and drove concurrency on the dedicated pool. Autoscale didn't ramp fast enough; queueing bumped p95. I'm digging into autoscale cooldown and burst pool config.

tess_eng: Can we throttle that batch or move it to a lower-priority pool? If we can shift to evening window or a dedicated burst quota that should help. Also can you paste traces? I'll correlate with KV cache hit rates.

alerts-bot: [ALERT] high-error-rate for acme-retail detected at 2025-01-10T17:21:00Z — 5xx rate 1.9% > threshold 0.5% (route: /generate, pool: eu-west-dedicated).

aj_kapoor: Assigning ownership to ben_platform to follow up on infra side. maria_cs can you capture the customer-facing note and whether this impacts renewal convo? any immediate churn risk flags?

maria_cs: Will do. CSM has a call Thurs with the account — primary concern is cost + intermittent latency spikes. Renewal not immediate risk today but worth raising as a potential concern if spikes repeat. Action items: (1) ben_platform investigate autoscale & job scheduling; (2) eng propose temp rate limit or priority for batch jobs; (3) tess_eng run token efficiency/quantization evals to reduce spend; (4) I'll prepare a short customer note and mitigation timeline for Thurs.

ben_platform: On it. Current autoscale: min_nodes=2, max_nodes=8, cooldown=120s. I'm experimenting with a burst pool and reducing cooldown for the eu-west-dedicated pool; also checking whether kernel selection caused CPU-side stalls for long sequences. Will report ETA ~4h.

tess_eng: I'll run a quick eval on gptx-13b token efficiency and a quantized 16->8-bit profile; preliminary estimate: ~12-18% cost reduction with negligible quality regression on length-100 prompts.

maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll update the customer thread once we have root cause and a short mitigation plan. cc: @aj_kapoor @ben_platform @tess_eng :thumbsup:
